semanticReview.method: Seguimiento R33 de fuente primaria gratuita: relectura del expediente anterior y cotejo de afirmaciones con localizadores exactos; una coincidencia parcial no certifica afirmaciones vecinas.
findings: лучше: comparativo irregular de хороший, invariabilidad, чем y lecturas de recomendación requieren cotejo lexicográfico/gramatical; no se verificaron todas las construcciones y sentidos.

The comparison grammar and Gramota.ru response support лучше as a simple comparative form related to хороший; they do not establish every claim about invariability, explicit чем, or recommendation use. Scope is Russian adjective grammar, not each entry-specific example or semantic nuance. | Грамота.ру. (2024, September 28). Ответ на вопрос № 317534: сравнительная степень прилагательных [Response to question 317534: Comparative forms of adjectives]. https://gramota.ru/spravka/vopros/317534 Locator: Answer dated 2024-09-28: states that хороший/плохой/маленький form simple comparative degrees from suppletive stems, including лучше, хуже, меньше; distinguishes худой ‘bad’ → хуже vs ‘thin’ → худее. Not a full paradigm source for every lexical item.
